n: Networked Audio Matrix and Processing Engine for d&b Soundscape,Up (DS110)
d: DS110Networked Audio Matrix and Processing Engine for d&b Soundscape,Up to 128 x 64 channels at 96 kHz,Dante, MADI, or mixed

specs.label: Input processing
specs.value: 8-Band PEQ with high/low shelf / Gain -120 to +24 dB / Delay up to 500 ms / Polarity 0° / 180° / Mute On/Off

specs.label: Matrix processing
specs.value: Level+Delay Matrix on each I/O crosspoint / Gain -120 to +10 dB / Delay On/Off up to 500 ms / Mute On/Off

specs.label: Output processing
specs.value: 16-Band PEQ with high/low shelf / Gain -120 to +10 dB / Delay up to 500 ms / Mute On/Off

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Push-button switch with integrated ring-LED indicator

specs.label: MADI
specs.value: 4 x MADI IN / 4 x MADI OUT / WORD CLOCK IN / WORD CLOCK OUT

specs.label: Remote control
specs.value: 2 x RJ45 / LAN 100/1000 Mbps / OCA/AES70, OSC
